note: GTA VI property registry — pre-launch stub. Schema v1.1 adds regions[], coordinates, and explicit monetary_dimension fields. Populate at launch from GTA VI wiki, Rockstar press kit, and community records.

fields.name: string
fields.type: string — apartment | safehouse | office | business | garage | warehouse | hangar | yacht | other
fields.coordinates: {x: number|null, y: number|null} — property entrance location
fields.upgrade_cost_gta$: number | null — full upgrade cost (monetary_dimension: price)
fields.daily_fee_gta$: number | null — GTA$/day upkeep when owned (monetary_dimension: cost)
fields.passive_yield_gta$_hr: number | null — passive income when not playing (monetary_dimension: yield)
fields.dlc: string — GTA VI launch or DLC name
fields.purchase_site: string | null — in-game website name (Dynasty 8 equivalent)

confirmed_pre_launch.note: Properties visible in official GTA VI trailers and press material
